title: A test that a value function ignores units
heading: A Test Restates Every Unit and Expects the Same Values
cases: a ranking lists names from the highest value down, equal values in name order
a normalized value function passes the check and a raw sum, whose first place moves, fails it
a raw sum whose first place holds but whose lower places swap still fails the check
two values equal but for floating-point rounding are a tie, so rounding alone never fails the check
values each within TIED of the next form one tied group, even when the ends are further apart
